mechanism_narrative: A rise in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2.5% annualized over the previous 6 months signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or CPI annualized growth > 2.5% does not correlate with subsequent tightening actions by the Fed.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points within the last month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or UNRATE increase > 0.5pp does not correlate with subsequent economic weakness indicators.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) over the last two months signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 50% of periods following RSAFS decline, or RSAFS decline does not correlate with subsequent GDP contraction.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 2% over the last two months signals supply-side constraints, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or INDPRO decline > 2% does not correlate with subsequent supply-side issues.

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) is rising, the combination signals a tightening monetary policy and inflationary pressure, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the combination of high FEDFUNDS and rising CPIAUCSL does not correlate with subsequent tightening actions by the Fed.

mechanism_narrative: When Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) show a decline of more than 100,000 jobs in a month and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises by more than 0.3 percentage points, it signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the combined labor market indicators do not correlate with subsequent economic weakness.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over the last two months signals strengthening demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 40% of periods following HOUST increase, or HOUST increase does not correlate with subsequent GDP growth.

mechanism_narrative: When GDP (GDPC1) growth slows below 2% annualized and Industrial Production (INDPRO) declines by more than 1% over the last quarter, it signals a supply-side slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the combined GDP and INDPRO slowdown does not correlate with subsequent economic contraction.
